# Video script: Adding colour to the sweep

> DRAFT - NOT FOR CLINICAL USE. Contains claims with status 'ai-extracted' that no clinician has verified.

Unit D7 | Target length: 5 min

| # | Shot | Narration | Claims |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Presenter to camera | Colour is not compulsory for screening. It is encouraged. Learn it on normal hearts first. | IS23-073 |
| 2 | Machine console: colour key, box size, scale control | Small box, only where you are looking. Scale fifty to seventy for the heart and arteries. Fifteen to twenty-five for veins. Persistence low. | IS23-076, IS23-077 |
| 3 | Split screen: grey-scale four-chamber beside the same view in colour | Keep grey-scale beside colour. Two valves, two streams filling the ventricles, both going forward. | IS23-041, IS23-074 |
| 4 | Outflow tract clips in colour | Forward flow through the aortic valve. Forward flow through the pulmonary valve. | IS23-074 |
| 5 | Three-vessel-and-trachea clip in colour | Two arches meeting in a V, the same colour. If one arch is the opposite colour, flow is reversed. That is not normal. | IS23-074 |
| 6 | Screen close-up of thermal index display | In early pregnancy, watch the thermal index. One or less. Keep it short. | IS23-093 |
